tooltip.mce_encoder.mechanical_craft_enc: Encodes a Create mechanical_crafting recipe into a cardboard package

Load in the materials of a crafting recipe and apply a redstone signal to get an "encoded" cardboard package; insert it into a Packager (with a wall of mechanical crafters behind it) to finish the craft automatically.
- The side filter on the machine accepts items: only recipes whose product passes the filter are encoded; a plain item limits it to that product, and an empty filter means no limit.
- The crafter wall may be larger than the recipe (e.g. 3x4/5x6 on a 9x9) - the encoder places the pattern on a corner of the wall automatically.
